description.value: Generic data from the ecoinvent v.3.6 database (system model allocation, cut-off) were used for primary products, raw materials and supplies as well as energy generation and disposal processes. Purchased parts for which no generic data was available were accounted for on the basis of the material composition. The highest proportion of environmental impacts is caused by the use phase, which is, however, based on assumptions about the daily usage time. For this reason, an average period of use was selected. However, even with a minimum daily usage time, the contribution of the usage phase would dominate. Use-Stage: To balance the usage phase, the scenario for an active product was selected in which the sensor consumes 80% of the load hours in standby mode with a consumption of 0.3 W. The sensor is active 20% of the time and consumes 1.1 W. The detector is never switched off. The presence detector consumes 40.03 kWh over a period of 10 years. The currently used Scenario is representative for one of the most likely scenario alternatives Transport to construction site: The customers of Steinel are B2B as well as B2C customers. This means that either partners with their own storage space or customers can be supplied directly. An average distance of 500 km was used to calculate the transport to the customer. Waste Scenario: For disposal purposes, it is assumed that the presence detector are recycled as electronic waste. The cut-off approach is used for recycling, whereby the secondary use of the material is cut off. Excluded processes are: Long-term emissions The manufacture of equipment used in production, buildings or any other capital goods; The transport of personnel to the plant; The transportation of personnel within the plant; Research and development activities.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value:
The sensors of the 3000-series are infrared presence detector.
The IS 3360 MX-E COM1 was used as the reference product for this representative EPD due to similar components and weights.
The presence detectors are produced at three locations and then stored in Herzebrock Clarholz and delivered to customers. All locations are certified in accordance with the environmental management standard 14001:2015. The Injection molded parts are produced at the Leipzig-Mölkau site. The resulting production waste, which averages 5%, can normally be reground and reused. However, we consider the 5% to be production waste in our calculation. The Printed circuit boards are produced in Einsiedeln. Here, the PCBs are fitted with electronic components using THT and SMD processes at the Swiss site in Einsiedeln. The preproducts manufactured in Mölkau and Einsiedeln are assembled and packaged in Curtea de Arges together with other purchased preproducts and then transported to the dispatch warehouse in Herzebrock-Clarholz. Steinel determined the electricity, gas, oil and water consumption per product for the sites by dividing the annual consumption by the production figures. The activity data collected by the company related to the year 2023.

Die Sensoren der 3000er-Serie sind Infrarot-Präsenzmelder.


Als Referenzprodukt für diese repräsentative EPD wurde der IS 3360 MX-E COM1 verwendet, da er über ähnliche Komponenten und Gewichte verfügt.


Die Präsenzmelder werden an drei Standorten produziert, anschließend in Herzebrock-Clarholz gelagert und an Kunden ausgeliefert. Alle Standorte sind nach der Umweltmanagementnorm ISO 14001:2015 zertifiziert.

 Die spritzgegossenen Kunststoffteile werden am Standort Leipzig-Mölkau hergestellt. Das dabei entstehende Produktionsabfallvolumen beträgt im Durchschnitt 5 % und kann in der Regel wieder aufbereitet und erneut verwendet werden. Für unsere Berechnungen wird dieser Anteil jedoch vollständig als Produktionsabfall berücksichtigt.

 Die Leiterplatten (PCBs) werden in Einsiedeln gefertigt. Dort werden sie am Schweizer Standort mittels THT- und SMD-Verfahren mit elektronischen Bauteilen bestückt.

 Die in Mölkau und Einsiedeln hergestellten Vorprodukte werden zusammen mit weiteren zugekauften Komponenten in Curtea de Argeș (Rumänien) montiert und verpackt und anschließend in das Versandlager nach Herzebrock-Clarholz transportiert.

 Steinel hat den Strom-, Gas-, Öl- und Wasserverbrauch pro Produkt ermittelt, indem der Jahresverbrauch durch die Produktionsmengen geteilt wurde. Die erfassten Aktivitätsdaten beziehen sich auf das Jahr 2023.

technologicalApplicability.value: Presence detectors are devices installed in buildings that are used to control, monitor and set up the lighting system. They enable automatic changes and scenario settings.

Präsenzmelder sind Geräte, die in Gebäuden installiert werden und zur Steuerung, Überwachung und Einrichtung des Beleuchtungssystems dienen.
 Sie ermöglichen automatische Schaltvorgänge sowie die Einstellung von Szenarien.
